name: Territorial inventory
definition: UNFCCC national inventory: emissions on Malta's territory, without LULUCF; international aviation and shipping only as memo items (Eurostat env_air_gge)

name: Residence accounts
definition: Eurostat air emissions accounts: emissions of Malta-resident units and households wherever they occur, including fuel Malta-based airlines buy abroad (env_ac_ainah_r2)

name: Effort-sharing scope
definition: The part of the inventory under the EU Effort Sharing Regulation: transport (except aviation CO2), buildings, small industry, waste, agriculture; not power generation

name: Denominators and context
definition: Population, GDP and energy series used to scale or explain emissions
